CVE-2026-42250.title: bzip2: bzip2: Denial of Service in bzip2recover via a specially crafted file
CVE-2026-42250.description: A flaw was found in bzip2. The bzip2recover utility contains an off-by-one error that allows a local attacker to cause an out-of-bounds write to a global buffer by processing a specially crafted file. This memory corruption can lead to a crash, resulting in a Denial of Service (DoS).
